node_kinds.name: SCIM_Organization
node_kinds.description: An organization or tenant in the IdP

markdown.content:
An identity provider organization or tenant whose users, groups, and/or role assignments are synchronized through SCIM. It provides the ownership boundary for those resources.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/scim/nodes/scim_organization)

node_kinds.name: SCIM_User
node_kinds.description: A user account provisioned via SCIM

markdown.content:
A user account provisioned through SCIM. If enabled in source and target systems, password synchronization may be performed.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/scim/nodes/scim_user)

A group provisioned through SCIM. Users and nested groups can be members. Configured membership synchronization propagates membership changes to linked groups, teams, or roles in other systems.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/scim/nodes/scim_group)

A role derived from the roles attribute of SCIM users, rather than a standalone SCIM resource.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/scim/nodes/scim_role)

Connects an organization to its SCIM users, groups, and roles. Each resource belongs to one organization, establishing its identity-provider ownership boundary.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/scim/edges/scim_contains)

relationship_kinds.name: SCIM_MemberOf
relationship_kinds.description: User or group is a member of a group

markdown.content:
Connects a user or nested group to its parent SCIM group. Membership is derived from group members and user groups attributes; synchronized membership changes can affect downstream application access.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/scim/edges/scim_memberof)

relationship_kinds.name: SCIM_HasRole
relationship_kinds.description: User is assigned to a role

markdown.content:
Connects a SCIM user to a role extracted from the user's roles attribute. It identifies users sharing a role assignment; it does not by itself describe the role's permissions.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/scim/edges/scim_hasrole)

relationship_kinds.name: SCIM_ManagerOf
relationship_kinds.description: User is a manager of another user

markdown.content:
Connects a manager to a direct report using the SCIM Enterprise User manager attribute. This non-traversable relationship provides organizational context, not an access path.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/scim/edges/scim_managerof)

relationship_kinds.name: SCIM_Provisioned
relationship_kinds.description: Resources are provisioned between source and target systems over the SCIM protocol

markdown.content:
Connects a source identity to its provisioned destination through a SCIM resource, following the direction of provisioning. This non-traversable relationship correlates identities; it does not establish authentication or access and does not imply password synchronization.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/scim/edges/scim_provisioned)

relationship_kinds.name: SCIM_MembershipSync
relationship_kinds.description: Group membership is synchronized between source and target systems over the SCIM protocol

markdown.content:
Represents configured membership synchronization from a source group to a destination group or team through a SCIM group. The edge follows the direction in which membership updates flow and can point into or out of the SCIM group.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/scim/edges/scim_membershipsync)

relationship_kinds.name: SCIM_PasswordSync
relationship_kinds.description: User passwords are synchronized between source and target systems over the SCIM protocol

markdown.content:
Represents configured password synchronization from a source user to a destination identity through a SCIM user. The edge follows password-update flow. Synchronization must be supported and enabled on both sides; provisioning alone does not imply it.

[Online documentation](https://bloodhound.specterops.io/opengraph/extensions/scim/edges/scim_passwordsync)
